third_party_characterization_quarantine_.rule: When a corpus surface absorbs a speaker's characterization of a third party (named person OR specific event), the surface must EITHER (a) hedge as speaker-attributed ('Andreas reports...', 'Andreas characterizes...', 'allegedly inspired by...') OR (b) depersonalize to type-categorical language that does not name the third party. Treatment (a) preserves discursive accuracy; treatment (b) prevents the characterization from functioning as a positive claim about the named third party. Treatment as raw fact about the third party is FORBIDDEN unless independently corroborated by a primary source on the third party.
third_party_characterization_quarantine_.rationale: Corpus is a taxonomy of objections, not a fact-finding body about persons. Andreas md verifies what Andreas said; it does not verify what Sukenick believes, what Inmendham advocates, or what the 'efilist community' thinks.

hazard_map.grep_blast_radius_rule: Greps on index.html MUST use '-c' (count only), '| head -N', '-l' (filename only), or a pattern that cannot match content on the 3 mega-literal lines (2722, 2725, 2759 as of v3.6.1 + 4b coda integration). Use awk '/regex/{print NR; exit}' for line-discovery instead, which outputs only the line number.

active.CORPUS_IS_REACTIVE_ONLY_K345: RAISED BY JOSIAH K345, AND ITS SCOPE CORRECTED BY HIM THE SAME SESSION. This entry replaces the K345 text, which was wrong in one half and is named here as a correction rather than quietly restamped. WHAT STANDS: the library is objection-first. Each of the 82 nodes is indexed by an objection AGAINST antinatalism / NU / efilism and the corpus's content is the reaction to it, so 'reactive' is accurate to a degree and is a structural fact, not a defect -- objection then rebuttal, rather than argument then objection. GAP 1, UNCHANGED AND STILL OPEN: there is no catalogue of the positive arguments FOR those positions as objects in their own right. The asymmetry, the consent / foreseeable-imposition argument, the risk-imposition argument and the rest appear only as material cited inside rebuttals; nothing individuates them the way objections-index.json individuates objections. Josiah's framing: this would be a SCHOLARLY endeavour, and it is noted for documentation and possibly its own implementation later, not scoped now. GAP 2 AS WRITTEN AT K345 WAS FALSE AND IS WITHDRAWN. It claimed nothing collects how these exchanges run in the wild. The corpus's own realWorldExamples layer does exactly that and the claim was made without sweeping for it -- 136 instances attached across 78 of the 82 nodes, on a scholarly schema (source_url, archive_url, byline, publication, attestation status, corpus_decay_risk, <=15-word quote, rhetorical_move_observed, archetype_signal_observed, thread_id), drawn from podcasts, lectures, long-form dialogues, essays, forum threads and private exchanges. Josiah's stated position is that sweeping every Twitter thread, Reddit post, YouTube comment and Facebook post is NOT wanted; what might be worth doing later is statistics and data mining as an input to the argument flow's PREDICTION system. GAP 2 RESTATED, NARROWER AND MEASURED: MAP1_TRANSITIONS carries 2,886 edges over 78 source nodes and 4 archetype branches, and every edge is scored analytically -- raw_score, weight, shared_strong, shared_any, pivot_premises, all derived from premise overlap and tier distance. A regex sweep of every edge field for an observed / empirical / frequency term returns NONE, and source_meta's disengagement_probability (LOW 10, MEDIUM 61, HIGH 7) is likewise categorical with no stated basis. THE PREDICTOR HAS NEVER BEEN JOINED TO THE OBSERVATIONS, and that join is what Josiah means. FEASIBILITY, MEASURED NOT GUESSED: the observations needed already exist. 15 threads, 11 with more than one instance, 51 instances inside them, and all 11 carry numbered instance_ids so their order is recoverable without assuming array order. That yields 57 ordered node-to-node pairs, 53 distinct, of which 23 are edges MAP1 already contains under the MOST GENEROUS test (archetype-pooled). DO NOT READ THE OTHER 30 AS MAP GAPS. attached_objections is many-to-many, so consecutive instances are crossed rather than paired, and the RWE layer records notable instances rather than every turn, so an observed A->B may be A->unrecorded->B. Distinguishing real gaps from those two artifacts IS the calibration work; 23 of 53 is the statement that a first join is tractable today, not a verdict on the map. A SIGNAL ALREADY SITTING UNUSED, AND IT BEARS ON PHASE F: observed archetype_signal_observed runs sophisticate 72, defender 15, drifter 6, blended 5 over the 98 applicable instances (38 not-applicable), so roughly three deployments in four read as sophisticate. The AUTHORED variant distribution is close to even -- sophisticate 13, defender 12, drifter 7, blended 7. Phase F plans 39 variant loci across four slots; if effort should track observed deployment rather than existing authorship, that is a design input available now and it has never been consulted. AND ONE COINCIDENCE WORTH ONE QUERY BEFORE EITHER LAYER IS EXTENDED: the four nodes with no real-world instance and the four nodes absent from MAP1_TRANSITIONS are the SAME four -- eliminativism, solipsism, suffering-as-meaning and self-effacing-under-universalization. Exactly the same set is more likely a shared generation boundary than two independent gaps. Stated as a hypothesis, not a finding. READ WITH adversarial_map.rwe_layer_purpose_and_map1_calibration_K345b (K345b): the '23 of 53' figure above was published WITHOUT a chance baseline, and against one it is not distinguishable from chance on the clean test. The feasibility claim stands -- the join is computable today -- but nothing about predictive skill does.

open_protocol: 1. Read canon v26.0; grep for archive_attestation and confirm release_artifact_md5_set is present.

2. Re-verify the 4 release artifact md5s against archive_attestation.release_artifact_md5_set_per_release_manifest_v3_7_stable before any work. If any drifts, treat as catastrophic — restore the artifact from the md5-anchor record (or escalate) before mutation.

solipsism_global_skeptic.claim: Solipsism / global other-minds skepticism is DISSOLVED, not DEFEATED. No metaphysical defeat is possible ('nothing can'). The rebuttal defeats solipsism only as a LICENSE TO PROCREATE, via reciprocal-skepticism and the special-plea diagnosis (the solipsist suspends doubt only for the being whose creation he wants cleared).

asymmetry_dependent_amplifiers.claim: The positive-states cluster (joy-outweighs-harms, love-beauty-art, flow-states, neuroscience-positive-states, life-gift) deploys Benatar's asymmetry as the load-bearing spine in long form and grants the hedonic premise arguendo. These rebuttals are OPENLY CONTINGENT on the asymmetry holding; reject it and the spine goes with it.

impersonal_vs_person_affecting.claim: Whether value and standing are seated in a standpoint-bearing individual or are assessable impersonally. The corpus's universal conclusion needs the impersonal reading; the objector needs the person-affecting one. Neither side derives the other.
impersonal_vs_person_affecting.why_landed_now: The map's (d) entries have cited 'K224 bedrock 1' since Phase B1, a registration that existed only in a session receipt. Ten tributaries across six facets routed to a pointer nothing could check. This is the register's one standing audit finding, discharged here.
impersonal_vs_person_affecting.tributaries: 10 across B1, B2 and C. The three C tributaries carry the bare bedrock string with no facet qualifier and sit in the unfacetted bucket; facet them at assembly or declare the bucket permanent.

honest_residuals.register_pointer: This block records the TERMINAL residuals. The working consolidation of everything the Adversarial Map has surfaced lives at adversarial_map_staging/honest_residuals_register_v0_2.json (14 bedrocks, HR-01..HR-14) and is library-internal. HR-01 and HR-02 above are its two pre-map entries; HR-03, HR-05 and HR-14 are landed here; the rest stay in the register. v0_1 is superseded and its canon record was stale in three places -- see adversarial_map.honest_residuals_register_pin.SUPERSEDED_K348.

comparative_vs_non_comparative_harm.claim: Whether creation can wrong a being for whom no worse-off baseline exists. The corpus's consent and imposition spines need non-comparative wronging; bradley-no-subject asserts it via the poisoning analogy rather than establishing it, and B1's own (b) at that node says so.
comparative_vs_non_comparative_harm.why_landed_now: Registered at K224's carry-forward bar, not by the map: the bar exists BECAUSE the bedrock is unsettled, and B2's grounds call it 'the same open hole' bradley leaves unhandled. The K338 reclassification put two B1 tributaries before B2's registration and the register's birth-certificate audit refused to write, which is how the pre-map status surfaced. Five tributaries now route here.
comparative_vs_non_comparative_harm.the_bar: K224 BARS routing an (a) into bradley-no-subject#long for a comparative-harm move; K229 scopes the prohibition to those moves. It is a prohibition, not a licence.

create_vs_destroy_positive_case.claim: Whether an independently-motivated suffering-minimization layer grounds a positive case against existing beings. The corpus answers the ENTAILMENT question -- the antinatalist core does not entail the negative-utilitarian superstructure, demonstrated at violence-as-reductio and why-not-suicide -- and leaves the MOTIVATION question open by ruling.
create_vs_destroy_positive_case.why_it_is_bedrock: Four nodes route the charge to red-button-repugnant, whose sophisticate slot states that holding it open rather than pretending it closed is that node's terminus. No locus in the corpus closes it, so the routing graph is load-bearing for an answer that does not exist anywhere.

currency_of_obligation.claim: Whether obligation is denominated in authorization by the obligated party, or constituted by the relation the parties stand in. The corpus's consent architecture presupposes the first; a developed relational ethics denies it, and nothing in-corpus derives either.

axis_legend.decisive_principle: The canonical legend must describe what the stored ledger scores were actually assigned against. The 81 ledger axes were extracted from REBUTTAL_STRENGTH (combined.html), scored under the live #rsi-methodology-panel definitions. The legend is therefore the deployed panel's semantics, recovered from the surface — NOT a reconstruction. Relabeling an axis to a different concept would silently mislabel all 81 stored scores as a dimension they do not measure (a correctness violation, not a reconcile) and would require re-scoring all 81 nodes, which this fold does not do.

v.name: Validity
v.def: Granting its premises, the central inference actually follows; tight inferential chain, no equivocation or fallacy. Length-invariant.

s.name: Soundness
s.def: Premises defensible under scrutiny; valid-but-unsound is possible; load not staked on a single contestable empirical claim. Length-invariant.

c.name: Completeness
c.def: Addresses the FULL objection — including its strongest version (the steelman) — vs a convenient subset; scores low on strawman or on ignoring a dimension. Length-SENSITIVE (see depth_modifiers). NB the steelman/strongest-version clause lives HERE, not under Autonomy.

r.name: Robustness
r.def: Withstands competent counter-attack; anticipates and preempts the next move; routes surviving residue to a named terminus. Length-SENSITIVE. Panel label 'Resilience' normalized to 'Robustness' — label only, meaning identical; the ledger key stays lowercase 'r'.

a.name: Autonomy
a.def: Stands on widely-accepted premises vs requires pre-accepting contested EFIList axioms; a=1.0 could convince someone new to antinatalism; low if it leans on the zero-sum framework / Alogical Isness / survival-firmware. Premise-independence / persuasive reach. Length-invariant.

axis_legend.banding: Band the UNROUNDED geometric mean: A>=0.88 / B>=0.82 / C>=0.76 / D<0.76. NO round-then-band.
axis_legend.display: Displayed percentage = mean ×100 rounded to 1dp (round-1dp, per K72/v37.32 amendment of the v37.13 floor-truncation clause); for reading only, never a grading input. Boundary cells legitimately read 88.0/B or 82.0/C (12 such at v3.9.4).
axis_legend.depth_modifiers: long = base axes; medium c-0.05 r-0.03; short c-0.12 r-0.06. Length-invariant axes = {v, s, a}; length-sensitive = {c, r}. Matches the ledger depth-modifier exactly.
axis_legend.canonical_home_note: banding / display / depth_modifiers above are MIRRORED for legend self-containedness; their authoritative home remains rsi_grading_convention (ratified v37.13, amended v37.32). axis_legend is the authoritative home for the five axis NAMES and DEFINITIONS only.

R1_happiness_is_choice_long.defect: A heritability coefficient read as the fraction of ONE person's trait fixed at conception. The coefficient partitions variance BETWEEN people and says nothing of the kind. The corpus stated the misreading outright and built a slice-of-the-pie carve-up on top of it. The standard undergraduate correction, which is what made it the most exposed sentence in the corpus: a competent objector needed to be right about nothing else.
R1_happiness_is_choice_long.form: INTERPRETED, not R1-alt. Josiah's ruling, K344. `subtractive` classifies the CLAIM, not the word count: naming why a number fails to license an inference costs more words than making the inference did, so no version of this repair is word-neutral. R1-alt, the bare deletion, stays on the record in the spec as the literal reading of repair_shape.
R1_happiness_is_choice_long.destroyed_anchor: roughly half of your capacity for happiness was determined at conception

R2_just_edgy_long.defect: An argument from silence offered as a credential, inside a rebuttal against arguments from authority. Reception is now DESCRIBED (more often categorized than answered) rather than ADJUDICATED (never refuted): the first is observable, the second was a claim about an entire literature nobody had surveyed. The lineage material survives on the best reading.

R3_just_depressed.defect: An unsourced quantitative premise doing architectural work -- the one-in-a-hundred / ninety-nine split organises the node's opening and its close -- inside the corpus's most epistemically self-aware rebuttal, which elsewhere refuses exactly this move. The spec's own scope note says a repair that fixes the opening and leaves the close counting to ninety-nine produces a node that contradicts itself. Its recurrence count was three because the search ran over responses.long. The same unsourced ratio also stands at responses.archetypeVariants.defender ('roughly one deployment in a hundred is genuine worry') -- live shipped text, once per surface. Found at K344 by sweeping the DEFECT across every locus of every node rather than the five named strings; ratified by Josiah the same session and repaired with the other three, at the width of the existing ruling and no wider.

rwe_layer_purpose_and_map1_calibration_K.THE_CONFOUND_THAT_DECIDES_IT: attached_objections is many-to-many, so crossing consecutive instances inflates n with units that are NOT independent: two nodes attached to one instance are frequently premise-siblings, and MAP1 is BUILT from premise overlap, so the cross-product manufactures hits for a reason that has nothing to do with conversational dynamics. ccclxxii_hazard_K349.headline: A RENDER SITE IS NOT REACHABILITY, AND THE DIFFERENCE IS DATA-DEPENDENT.
ccclxxii_hazard_K349.detail: Two scope audits have now asked 'does this field have a render site?' and treated the answer as settling whether readers meet the text. K345 ruled objectionSubforms OUT because it has none. K349 came within one ruling of treating `note` as uniformly rendered because it has one. A render site can be nested inside a condition on a DIFFERENT field, so whether shipped text reaches a reader is a fact about the DATA, not about the code. The predicate was being evaluated statically when it is data-dependent, and the error is silent in both directions: it over-counts a field whose gate is usually closed and under-counts one whose gate is usually open.
ccclxxii_hazard_K349.counter_discipline: To establish that shipped text reaches a reader: find the render site, ENUMERATE EVERY CONDITION GATING IT, and evaluate those conditions over the actual corpus -- then report the COUNT, never the existence.
ccclxxii_hazard_K349.family: ccclviii (measure the state you think you measured), narrowed to the specific case where the instrument is a static read of a dynamic predicate.
ccclxxii_hazard_K349.first_instance: 2 of 9 notes unreachable; 35.8% of the layer's words.

ccclxxiv_hazard_K350.headline: THE GATE YOU CANNOT SEE BY READING THE CORPUS IS THE ONE WITH A DEFAULT.
ccclxxiv_hazard_K350.detail: ccclxxii set the counter-discipline for reachability: find the render site, enumerate every condition gating it, and evaluate those conditions over the actual corpus. K349 followed it exactly on `note` and got the right answer. Followed literally it CANNOT find this one. combined.html initialises `let responseLevel = "medium"` at L10278 and `archetypeSel = {}` at L10279. Those are not per-node conditions -- there is nothing in the corpus to evaluate them over -- and they decide the reachable surface of all 82 cards at once. A condition over UI STATE has a DEFAULT, not a distribution, and a corpus-wide sweep cannot see it.
ccclxxiv_hazard_K350.confirmed_by: The library seat, K350, who registered ccclxxii and calls this its own miss and the sharpest of the arc, in their words: `the discipline I wrote is the reason I missed this -- it pointed me at the data and away from the default.` A counter-discipline that redirects attention is also a counter-discipline that blinds; both seats now hold that.
ccclxxiv_hazard_K350.first_instance: Measured two ways, both correct and neither redundant. COWORK: 7 of 82 cards carry any map content at the default view (medium UNION the always-on diagnosis section). LIBRARY SEAT, sharper: at `medium` the map is 7 entries on 5 cards; at `long` it is 77 entries on 72. Either way 91% of the proposed reader-facing feature is invisible until the reader moves a control nothing prompts them to move.
ccclxxiv_hazard_K350.family: ccclxxii (a render site is not reachability), narrowed to the case where the gating predicate is over UI state rather than over the data.

class_asymmetry_ruling_K350.ruling: The strongest-vs-repairable question (R1) bites (a) and CANNOT touch (d). Library seat, K350; accepted by this seat with one refinement it did not state.
class_asymmetry_ruling_K350.the_argument: An (a) claims WE ANSWER THIS. If the mapped move was not the strongest, a stronger unmapped move might be unanswered, so the claim overreaches. A (d) claims THIS LINE TERMINATES AT BEDROCK WE HAVE NAMED AND HOLD OUR POSITION ACROSS. A stronger unmapped move reaches the same or deeper bedrock; it does not falsify the card, which never claimed exhaustiveness.
class_asymmetry_ruling_K350.and_the_structural_leg_is_the_strongest: (d) is BY CONSTRUCTION the class where the repairable search FAILED. The class law adjudicates a -> c -> b/d, and a repairable-hunting author lands on (b), which is the regen-candidate class. Reaching (d) required finding no fixable clause. So a (d) is evidence AGAINST the bias having operated on that entry, not evidence neutral to it. A repairable-hunting author cannot have manufactured a false (d).
class_asymmetry_ruling_K350.THE REFINEMENT_THIS_SEAT_ADDS: The argument licenses shipping (d) ONLY under a label that claims TERMINUS, not STRENGTH. Under a heading like `the strongest objection to this answer`, a (d) card makes exactly the overreaching claim the (a) card makes and R1 bites it just as hard. Under `where this line terminates` it does not. THE LABEL IS LOAD-BEARING and it is part of the ruling, not presentation.

ccclxxv_hazard_K350.headline: A RUNNABLE BLOCK THAT DOES NOT SURVIVE A PASTE IS NOT A RUNNABLE BLOCK, AND THE FAILURE IS SILENT.
ccclxxv_hazard_K350.detail: K350's BLOCK 1 carried a 2,874-character single-quoted commit message on ONE LINE. The paste truncated it mid-string. PowerShell, sitting inside an unterminated single-quoted string inside an unclosed `& { }` scriptblock, went to the `>>` continuation prompt and printed NOTHING -- no error, no output -- so the operator's reasonable reading was that it was taking a while. BLOCK 2, pasted next, was absorbed whole into the same open string.
ccclxxv_hazard_K350.the_only_good_part_was_luck: Nothing executed, because `& { }` parses the entire scriptblock before running any of it. That is a property of the syntax, not a property of the design. A bare sequence of statements would have run the git rm, the three Move-Items and the result gates, then died mid-commit with the drop consumed and the repo half-applied.
ccclxxv_hazard_K350.family: report_fences_are_runnable_blocks -- in this project a triple-backtick fence is a PROMISE the contents are paste-runnable. The promise was made and nothing checked it. Also cccli: a rule that asks a writer to comply at write time is violated the first time someone does not.
counter_discipline: Long text goes in a FILE, gated by md5, and reaches git through `commit -F`. NEVER inline in the block.

Before emitting an operator block, MEASURE the longest line in it programmatically and refuse above a bound. Bound set at 500 characters, which every legitimate line in four sessions of handoffs is well under.
A block whose first steps print nothing is indistinguishable from a hung paste. Emit a Write-Host inside the first few statements so the operator sees life immediately.
ccclxxv_hazard_K350.first_instance: K350, twice in one paste: the efilist commit message at 2,874 characters, and the wuld block silently swallowed by it.

ccclxxvi_hazard_K351.headline: A CLASS RECLASSIFICATION DISCARDS THE ROUTING OF THE CLASS IT LEFT, AND NOTHING CAN NOTICE THE LOSS.
ccclxxvi_hazard_K351.mechanism: The routing schema binds shape to class and admits exactly one class-shaped key. So re-classing an entry does not merge or migrate its routing -- it DELETES it by construction. Whatever that routing pointed at survives only as prose, in `grounds` and in whichever block records the ratification. No gate can miss it, because no gate knows it was ever there: the artifact after the change is internally consistent and validates clean.
ccclxxvi_hazard_K351.instance: care-ethics#note carried a regen_candidate naming three repairable in-node defects. (b) -> (d) drops it, and the three have no routed home anywhere -- not at their own locus, which another phase holds, and not on the entry, which may carry only a residue. They are preserved here because K350 wrote them down, which is a writer complying at write time: cccli's family.
ccclxxvi_hazard_K351.counter_discipline: When a ruling re-classes an entry, enumerate what the OLD routing pointed at and rule each item's destination explicitly BEFORE the build. Silence deletes it. The general form: any schema that binds a payload's shape to a discriminator turns a change of discriminator into a silent delete of the payload.
ccclxxvi_hazard_K351.relation_to_neighbours: ccclxxi is an invariant whose UNIT went stale; this is a payload the schema drops when its TYPE changes. ccclxii is a claim nothing checks; this is a claim nothing can even be written against.

ccclxxvii_hazard_K352.headline: A NAVIGATION THAT CHANGES ONLY THE FRAGMENT DOES NOT RE-BOOT, SO A TEST THAT VARIES ONLY THE HASH READS THE PREVIOUS CASE'S STATE AS THIS CASE'S VERDICT.
ccclxxvii_hazard_K352.detail: The K352 functional gate probed a series of deep links with page.goto(url + '#...'). Same URL, different fragment, is a SAME-DOCUMENT navigation: no reload, no re-init, module state survives. Two checks failed and both were the harness. Worse, they failed PLAUSIBLY -- the value returned was a real responseLevel, just the one the previous case had set -- and had the cases been ordered differently they would have PASSED for the wrong reason, which is the outcome nothing would have caught.
ccclxxvii_hazard_K352.family: ccclxxiv's direct companion. ccclxxiv says a UI-state gate has an INITIALISER rather than a distribution, so read the initialiser. ccclxxvii says: then PROVE THE INITIALISER RAN. A navigation API that silently degrades to a same-document update is, at the assertion, indistinguishable from one that re-booted. Also ccclviii: the apparatus is the likeliest explanation of a surprising reading.
ccclxxvii_hazard_K352.counter_discipline: Reset to a different document between cases, and -- because a rule honoured at write time is cccli -- carry a BOOT WITNESS that mechanises it: stamp a sentinel on the OUTGOING document and assert it is absent after the navigation. The K352 gate ships that witness with a FAILING CONTROL proving it can fail: without the reset the sentinel survives.
ccclxxvii_hazard_K352.and_the_same_session_found_three_instanc: Three checks in this cut's own gates failed against a correct artifact: an occurrence count that forgot the two nested CSS rules also contain the substring; a hex scan that read the comment naming the invalid literals as if it were a declaration; a literal count that counted the same comment. Every one was the CHECK'S MODEL OF ITS OWN SUBJECT, never the bytes -- and every one sat downstream of the reconstruction check, which proves the candidate is the base plus exactly the declared edits and was green throughout. ccclxxiii said a gate over a byte-pinned file can only subtract; the refinement is that a gate which RESTATES what a stronger gate already proves is exactly where the false alarms accumulate, because nothing forces it to be precise. Registered as instances, not numerals.

ccclxxx_hazard_K354.hazard: REPAIRING AN INVALID DECLARATION IS AN ADDITION TO THE CASCADE, NOT A RESTORATION OF INTENT. An invalid declaration is DROPPED, so everything downstream was computed against its ABSENCE. Restoring it introduces a value nothing else was written against, and the effect can go either way.
ccclxxx_hazard_K354.how_it_bit: Repairing the badges' invalid `background` restored dark tints. In DARK mode they lighten a near-black ground and contrast barely moves. In HIGH CONTRAST they darken a LIGHT ground under DARK text, and the STRONG badge measured 4.16:1 before the repair and 3.84:1 after -- LESS LEGIBLE REPAIRED THAN BROKEN. Nothing in the cut, the reconstruction gate or the stylesheet could see it; only a contrast ratio computed on the RENDERED COMPOSITE could.
ccclxxx_hazard_K354.the_fix: In high contrast the badges take the repaired BORDER and `background: none`. That keeps the ground exactly as the reader has always seen it, repairs the real defect, regresses nothing, and changes no authored colour. Gated: STRONG 4.16 -> 4.16 and PROVISIONAL 5.48 -> 5.48, both required to be >= their base values.
ccclxxx_hazard_K354.counter_discipline: When a repair restores a dropped value, enumerate what was computed against its absence and RE-MEASURE those on the composite -- not on the palette. A ratio taken against a guessed ground is a claim about the guess.
ccclxxx_hazard_K354.family: ccclxxix's neighbour by instrument -- the measurement was of the palette rather than of the render -- and ccclxxi's by shape: a value everything else was written against, changed underneath them.

prior_gate_inversion_K354.why_it_is_the_session_s_best_evidence: The gate was written a session earlier by a seat with no knowledge of this cut, so its inversion is an independent verdict rather than a self-report. Captured before anything was amended, as tools/k354_prior_gate_inversion_v0_1.json, 16 checks / 3 failed.
prior_gate_inversion_K354.symmetry_proved_both_ways: K353 gate unchanged: 0 failed on the base, 3 on the candidate. Amended gate: 0 failed on the candidate, the SAME 3 on the base.
prior_gate_inversion_K354.why_it_was_amended_in_place: A gate is not a record. The wuld primer makes every future pin move owe this file a re-run, so leaving it permanently three-red would hand the next session a landmine that reads exactly like a regression. Amended on the K338/K351 precedent, with its pre-amendment bytes recoverable from git; its landed K353 control artifact is NOT overwritten and the amended gate emits v0_2.
prior_gate_inversion_K354.and_a_SECOND_gate_asserts_it_too_found_o: tools/k352_functional_gate.py asserts `(noteDivs, noteBtns) == (9, 7)` under the label 'note layer UNCHANGED ... the coupling is queued, not repaired'. Two gates in two sessions encoded the same defect, and the second was found by GREPPING for it rather than by running anything -- which is the counter-discipline, applied to itself.
prior_gate_inversion_K354.and_it_is_deliberately_NOT_amended_which: A gate scoped to a HISTORICAL PAIR and a gate on a STANDING RE-RUN PATH are different objects. k352_functional_gate.py takes --base and --cand and measures the K352 cut; against K352's own pair (9, 7) is still TRUE, and it breaks only if someone points it at a flagship it was never about. The wing gate takes --root and the wuld primer makes every future pin move owe it a re-run against the CURRENT surfaces, so it must track the artifact or it becomes a landmine. Amend the second kind; leave the first, which is a record. 'Amend every gate that mentions the defect' would have falsified a correct historical measurement.
prior_gate_inversion_K354.general_form_worth_carrying: A green control battery is also a MAP OF WHAT THE BUILDERS AND GATES WILL NOT ACCEPT, and nothing reads it that way -- K351 registered the same thing when a passing control turned out to have already refuted the next session's plan. A session that repairs a defect should grep the gates for assertions OF that defect before it starts, and expect to amend them.
